title: Chapter 220
text:
The battle only lasted for fifteen minutes before it ended. The waves of steel slaughtered the swarm of insects, and the ground was covered in green liquid. The smell evaporated under the high temperature, making it extremely pungent.

The team was unscathed. Everyone looked at Han Xiao, who was smoking calmly, and felt very safe. They were worried when they left the shelter. After all, Blue Star had many dangers in the wilderness, but now it seemed that as long as Han Xiao was there, there would be no danger.

Liu Chao realized that the guards he led had become the targets of protection. He could not help but admire Han Xiao. The strong were always sought after.

Your mechanical creation has killed the Desert Blood Shell Pincer (LV15). You have received 10 EXP.

If one's own level was too much higher than the monster's level, the EXP would be greatly reduced. One insect only gave 10 EXP, but there were at least ten thousand of them. Han Xiao looked at the interface and received more than 100,000 EXP.

The hovering helicopter landed. Huang Yu looked down from the helicopter and saw the endless swarm of insects falling like wheat, but the camp remained unmoved. The countless bullets were like blooming petals. The scene shocked him deeply.

Huang Yu originally planned to escape on the helicopter and almost left the others behind. Now that the crisis was over, his expression became a little awkward. He felt that the eyes of the people around him were full of contempt and dissatisfaction.

"The Mechanic class is so strong …" Hao Tian held Bear Cub and frowned. He was a Pugilist, so he could not help but worry about his career prospects.

On the other hand, Mad Blade, who was a Pugilist in his previous life, was more and more glad that he chose the Mechanic class. This was very awkward …

"More material." Pork Bun was very happy. Following Black Phantom, there was no need to worry about not having enough content to make videos.

The three players also triggered the mission of protecting the team, but they did not do much and received a lot of EXP. The other two were not surprised, but it was the first time Hao Tian experienced it.

Looking at the huge increase in EXP, Hao Tian had mixed feelings. The reward of doing missions was not as good as following Han Xiao.

No wonder so many people wanted to trigger Black Phantom's hidden storyline. The reward was so good that even he, a professional god, had a similar thought.

The dangers of the wilderness came from wild beasts, bandits, and radioactive dust. With the protection of this group of steel weapons, they encountered several wild beasts along the way, but they were all defeated. It was scary but not dangerous.

…

With only one day's journey to Graymetal Ruins, the caravan set up camp.

The starry night was bright, and countless stars twinkled in the night sky. It was a clear night, and when one looked up, one could see a whole river of stars reflected in one's eyes. The technological environment of Blue Star was similar to that of Earth, but the natural environment was more beautiful.

The coordinates were the ninth Star Zone of the Garton Galaxy. The civilization density in this Star Zone was very low, but the planets were very dense. A large number of desolate planets were quietly captured by the denser planets and moved around them. The Blue Star revolved around a star, neither too close nor too far. The temperature was suitable for human habitation. The Blue Star is also orbited by several satellites (satellites in the celestial sense). These are the "moons" that reflect the light of the star onto the planet's rotating dark side.

Before the Old Era, there were countries that built rockets to land on the satellites, but the planets were desolate.

The opportunity for the Godora Civilization to come into contact with the Blue Star Civilization was when a Godora exploration star shuttle's interstellar spectrometer captured the vacuum noise of a low-tech rocket made by the Blue Star Civilization.

Godora was a Star System level civilization that dominated the Garton Galaxy. Their exploration area covered many Star Zones in the Garton Galaxy. They leaned toward the lawful faction and had a friendly attitude toward civilization contact.

Han Xiao had recently seen the Blue Star Civilization's research on celestial bodies. This information could be obtained by the players through various channels, and the details were very realistic. Therefore, the players had a strong sense of immersion. From the perspective of an NPC, Han Xiao was able to see more things.

In the tent, Han Xiao and Coney Fury were discussing the blueprint. At this time, a guard walked in and reported.

"Your Excellency, we've captured a wanderer. He's wandering around our camp."

This was a young wanderer. His clothes were ragged, and he had a double-barreled shotgun that was confiscated by the guards. When he saw that the camp was filled with armed guards, fear appeared on his face, and he started to tremble.

"Are there any settlements nearby?" Han Xiao had an idea. He turned around and asked.

Liu Chao looked at the map and said, "There are a few medium-sized settlements."

Han Xiao nodded and stared at the young man thoughtfully. The young man only felt that the gaze of the man in black in front of him was oppressive, making his legs weak. Without waiting for Han Xiao to ask, he explained in a trembling voice, "I'm a wanderer from a nearby settlement. I came out to hunt and happened to see you passing by, so I wanted to take a closer look …"

Han Xiao touched his chin and thought for a few seconds. Seeing that the young man was thin and sallow, he said, "Liu Chao, give him some food."

The young man was stunned.

"Go back and tell the people in your settlement that our group will be building a city in the Graymetal Ruins. We'll provide plenty of job opportunities and pay them well. If they want to settle down, we welcome them. Tell your chief that I hope they'll move in."

The heavy bag of food made the young man come back to his senses. He suddenly showed a surprised expression.

He was a hunter in the settlement. Recently, he had not hunted any prey. The people in the settlement could only eat 30% of their fill every day. The food was enough for them to eat a few meals.

When he was caught, the young man was very scared. Now that he found that these people were not bad people, he was slightly relieved. He secretly thought about Han Xiao's proposal.

Most wanderers did not have enough to eat. If they could exchange work for food, it was indeed very attractive.

After sending the young man away, Han Xiao took out the map and said, "The Graymetal Ruins are very desolate. There are no signs of life within fifteen kilometers of it, but further away, there are more than ten settlements scattered around. Most of them are small, with a total of two to three thousand people. Liu Chao, gather some people and bring food to spread the news of us building a shelter."

The purpose of a sanctuary was to shelter the refugees in the wilderness, so it was normal to attract wanderers. Huang Yu thought that he saw through Han Xiao's plan. He thought to himself, So, he wants to hire wanderers as workers, but it's still too little.

Han Xiao wanted to complete the blueprint of the sanctuary in a month, so he would need at least 100,000 people. This was far from enough.

Huang Yu shook his head. He was not optimistic about the one-month plan. It would most likely fail, but it would not cause any loss to the organization. The only thing that would be damaged was Black Phantom's reputation and face. If he could not fulfill his promise, the other upper management's opinion of Han Xiao would naturally decrease.

"Anyway, I'll apply to be transferred back to the headquarters after a month." Huang Yu did not want to be an assistant and waste his time in Sanctuary Three without any chance to make any contributions.

Not mentioning Huang Yu's thoughts, Liu Chao said, "But if we split up the guards, the defense of the team won't be enough …"

Han Xiao pointed at the Generation 2.5 Rangers that were patrolling the camp according to the program and laughed.

"I'll give you a chance to say that again."

"I promise to complete the mission." Liu Chao immediately changed his words and stood at attention.

…

The endless Gorst Wasteland, the brownish-red ground was like solidified blood. Returning to this place again, the scenery was very familiar.

Speaking of which, I haven't been back to the base for a long time, Han Xiao thought. The base had always been in standby mode, so he did not use it much.

Graymetal Ruins, the outline of this abandoned city, appeared in his vision.

There used to be a road in the wasteland, but it had been neglected for many years, so it was overgrown with weeds. The cement road was cracked, and green sprouted from the cracks. There were also old grayish-yellow newspapers that were blown by the wind and moved slowly on the road. The street lamps that were no longer lit were covered with vines.

The atmosphere was bleak.

The entrance to Graymetal Ruins was a wide abandoned road. The fleet moved along the road. Other than the sound of the engine and wheels, it was completely silent.

Arrived at Graymetal Ruins. Current Team Size: 1,034. Damage Rate: 0%

Target completed.

You have received 250000 EXP.

Mission Rating increased to D-.

The main mission of the sanctuary that Han Xiao had received was [Build Sanctuary Three]. It was a huge mission that involved the overall situation. Therefore, according to the dozens of buildings that a sanctuary should have, there were dozens of construction requirements.

The current target of the mission had changed.

Current Target: Complete the blueprint. Time limit: 3 months

Current Time: Day 1

Complete the following 13 construction requirements [Expand/Retract] within 3 months. Reward: 800,000 EXP, + 1,250 Dark Net Reputation, Mission Rating increased.
